messages:
Mira: Morning fam! Two quick cheers — Mia just got promoted to Senior Software Engineer 🎉 and Diego & Priya welcomed a baby girl last night 🍼😍. Can we do a small office cake + card?
Alex: Yesss congrats all around!! :tada:
Mia: omg thank you!!! so grateful to this team <3
Priya: she's 7lb 2oz, name is Noor. Pics in #off-topic-photos. thanks everyone ❤️
Diego: thanks folks — I’m still a bit jetlagged but reading every message. happy to chip in for cake/delivery.
Jen: Poll time — React with one: 1️⃣ cake in kitchen @3pm, 2️⃣ savory potluck, 3️⃣ send gift card, 4️⃣ virtual card only
Alex: 1️⃣ from me — cake pls
Mira: 1️⃣ as well, small gluten-free option?
Priya: GF option would be amazing, thank you.
Kudos-bot: Mia promoted → Senior Software Engineer. Congrats +1 badge awarded :medal:
CalendarBot: Event created: "Congrats — Mia & Noor (Cake)" on 2026-03-28 15:00 in Main Kitchen. Invite sent to #random.
Diego: If anyone wants to contribute $ for a delivery, I can DM a Venmo link.
Mia: I’ll be there for a quick hello — don’t make it a whole production please 😂
Jen: Noted, tiny and cozy. I'll grab a cake and GF slices. Thanks everyone! :cake:
